# smart-base-code-lists

The GRADE code lists (certainty of evidence, reasons to rate certainty down and up, the Evidence-to-Decision criteria, and recommendation direction and strength), one `"$schema": "folio-code-list/v1"` file per list, read with the `grade` skill; and the SMART Guidelines KG class lists `sgkg-l1-classes.json` and `sgkg-l2-classes.json`, the class ids document kinds name in `modelledBy` (read by `smart-base/scripts/kg-classes.ts`). Only this layer's own lists; the harness's generic lists reach it through the dependency overlay.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-code-lists`, holding `code-list`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`grade-certainty.json`](grade-certainty.json) | GRADE certainty of evidence |  |
| [`grade-etd-criterion.json`](grade-etd-criterion.json) | GRADE Evidence-to-Decision criteria |  |
| [`grade-rating-down.json`](grade-rating-down.json) | GRADE reasons to rate certainty down |  |
| [`grade-rating-up.json`](grade-rating-up.json) | GRADE reasons to rate certainty up |  |
| [`grade-recommendation-direction.json`](grade-recommendation-direction.json) | GRADE recommendation direction |  |
| [`grade-recommendation-strength.json`](grade-recommendation-strength.json) | GRADE recommendation strength |  |
| [`sgkg-l1-classes.json`](sgkg-l1-classes.json) | SMART Guidelines KG L1 classes |  |
| [`sgkg-l2-bpmn-classes.json`](sgkg-l2-bpmn-classes.json) | SMART Guidelines KG L2-BPMN classes |  |
| [`sgkg-l2-classes.json`](sgkg-l2-classes.json) | SMART Guidelines KG L2 classes |  |
| [`sgkg-l2-dmn-classes.json`](sgkg-l2-dmn-classes.json) | SMART Guidelines KG L2-DMN classes |  |
| [`sgkg-l3-classes.json`](sgkg-l3-classes.json) | SMART Guidelines KG L3 classes |  |
